facts.text: High-Gain Communications Antenna was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
Gimbaled high-gain antenna dish transmitting Ka-band science data back to NASA's Deep Space Network at 4.3 Mbps.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Beamed down 678 gigabytes of uncompressed photometric light curves containing the signatures of thousands of worlds.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit.
Delivered the scientific data that established the field of exoplanetary statistics.
